findings.message: <html> has no lang attribute; screen readers guess the pronunciation
findings.fix: add lang="en" (or the page language) to <html>

findings.message: the page has no (or an empty) <title>
findings.fix: add a unique, descriptive <title>: 'Page topic - Site name'

findings.message: viewport blocks zoom (width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no)
findings.fix: remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale (or set maximum-scale>=5)
use a server-side redirect, or let the user extend/stop the timer
describe the image in alt="...", or alt="" if it is purely decorative

findings.message: alt='IMG_2041.jpg' looks like a file name or placeholder
findings.fix: write what the image shows or does; use alt='' if decorative

findings.message: alt='image' looks like a file name or placeholder
findings.fix: write what the image shows or does; use alt='' if decorative
add alt describing the action, e.g. alt='Search'
add <title> as first child or aria-label; use aria-hidden="true" if decorative

findings.message: link to '/' has no accessible name
findings.fix: add link text, alt text on the image inside it, or aria-label

findings.message: link to '/cart' has no accessible name
findings.fix: add link text, alt text on the image inside it, or aria-label
add visible text, aria-label, or visually hidden text inside the button

findings.message: link text 'Click here' does not say where it goes
findings.fix: make the text describe the target ('Read more about pricing') or add visually hidden text

findings.message: link opens a new window without saying so
findings.fix: add '(opens in a new tab)' to the text or a visually hidden span

findings.message: <input type=text> has no label (placeholder is not a label)
findings.fix: add <label for='id'>, wrap it in <label>, or use aria-labelledby pointing at visible text
add <label for='id'>, wrap it in <label>, or use aria-labelledby pointing at visible text
add <label for='id'>, wrap it in <label>, or use aria-labelledby pointing at visible text
make for= match the control's id

findings.message: heading level jumps from h1 to h4
findings.fix: use h2 here (style it with CSS if it must look smaller)
remove it or give it text; do not use headings for spacing
make ids unique; labels and ARIA references pick the first one only

findings.message: tabindex=3 changes the natural focus order
findings.fix: use tabindex="0" (or none) and fix the DOM order instead
add title describing the content, e.g. title='Map of our office'

findings.message: data table (2 rows) has no <th> header cells
findings.fix: mark header cells as <th scope="col"> / <th scope="row">, or role="presentation" for layout tables
remove autoplay, or add muted; provide a pause/stop and volume control
add <track kind="captions" src="..." srclang="en" label="English"> (skip if the video has no speech)
remove autoplay, or add muted; provide a pause/stop and volume control

findings.message: <marquee> moves or blinks with no way to stop it
findings.fix: remove it; use static text
wrap the primary content in <main> (one per page)
